method.quarterly: Direct published average daily available and occupied overnight-bed rows from each quarterly workbook.
method.annual: Day-weighted average of Q1 to Q4 using 91, 92, 92 and 90 calendar days. Occupancy is annual occupied bed-days divided by annual available bed-days.
method.geography: Provider geography only; no ICB attribution is inferred.

notes: General and acute beds exclude maternity and mental-health sectors; the full sector profile remains available in the details panel.
Available means beds open for use during the reporting period, expressed as an average daily number.
Occupancy is not case-mix adjusted and a high rate does not by itself establish unsafe care.
Some quarterly returns were estimated or revised; the source workbooks' data-quality notes remain authoritative.
